newsitem.title: USA: GAO says no decision yet on review of Fed banks.
newsitem.headline: GAO says no decision yet on review of Fed banks.

text.p: The General Accounting Office, a Congressional watchdog agency, on Wednesday said it had not made a decision yet on a request to review the cash accounting systems of the 12 regional Fed banks.
"We will look at the work the Fed's external auditors have done and then we will look at what is feasible for our staff to do," said a GAO spokeswoman.
After the completion of a GAO report on the Fed's Los Angeles branch, Rep. Henry Gonzalez (D-Texas) asked the GAO to review the cash tallying systems for all of the regional Fed banks.
